Implement reproducible environments, least-privilege runtime identities, content-addressed artifacts, progressive delivery, rollback, and correlated telemetry. Keep authoritative state out of ephemeral queues. Every production change requires a documented rollback and approval boundary.

Do not run unrestricted cloud mutation or incur spend without the required human gate.
